package.installed_from: PyPI wheel jos3-0.5.0-py3-none-any.whl in a throwaway venv (decision D8)

_meta.protocol: steady: 24 h (JOS-3 needs 12-24 h in the cold) at the given air = radiant temperature, the settle in 10 minute steps and the reported minute in a 1 minute step; step: 24 h at the first temperature, then the second for the minutes given in 1 minute steps; nude unless Icl_clo > 0; wind 0.1 m/s; the sim's rest power unless the level says otherwise (see the docstring of tools/jos3_oracle.py)

skin_mean.jos3_meaning: Mean skin temperature of the body

heat_prod_W.jos3_meaning: Total heat production of the whole body

sweat_Lh.jos3_meaning: Evaporative heat loss at the skin by only sweating of the body part
sweat_Lh.how: sum over 17 segments, W / 2418 J/g * 3600 s/h / 1000 g/L

wet_mean.jos3_meaning: Mean skin wettedness of the body

notes: cases = the T7 spec cases at the sim's own rest power (what the existing test reads); extra_cases = more steady states at the same rest power (31 C, the middle of the neutral zone); variants = the same cases at PAR 1.00 and PAR 1.25, and the human-chamber conditions (seated, clothed) at all three levels
core is the central blood pool Tcb; the segment cores (core_head, core_pelvis, core_chest) are kept beside it
sweat_Lh is the evaporated sweat equivalent (Esweat); JOS-3 has no run-off; it equals the controller's demand while wet_max < 1
